services.name: Private 2 Hour River Cruise | Up to 10 Passengers
services.desc: Throw a pizza party while cruising the Chicago River! Why take a tour with a bunch of strangers when you could throw a pizza party on a private pontoon boat for just you and your friends? Avoid the crowds and cruise with BBQ Pontoon instead! When you rent a boat with us you’re the captain, so you can take in all of Chicago’s architectural wonders at your own pace and with whomever you want. We even give you a free pizza to cook while you sit back and relax during your Chicago pontoon rental. We also have free parking! Our boat rentals provide the perfect experience to share with family, friends or guests from out of town. This is a unique way to see the city, and the views from the river

services.name: Private 2.5 Hour Fireworks Cruise | Up to 8 Passengers
services.desc: Watch the fireworks on the Chicago River from your own pontoon boat Chicago’s majestic architecture really comes alive at night. As the sun goes down, the city lights up, and the skyscrapers brighten the horizon for miles. Wednesday and Saturday evenings are especially romantic thanks to the Navy Pier fireworks, which occur throughout the summer from Memorial Day to Labor Day. What better way to see these spectacular light shows than from the Chicago River, on a fun and relaxing private pontoon boat? With BBQ Pontoon, you can cruise the Chicago River while experiencing an unobstructed view of the Navy Pier fireworks. Our boat rentals come with one free pizza to cook in the gas-fired grill

includes: Our boat rentals come with one free pizza to cook in the gas-fired grill that is included on each pontoon boat.
blurb: Guests rent a private pontoon boat for a self-guided cruise on the Chicago River. The boat holds up to 10 passengers depending on the cruise option. Pizza is included during the cruise.
